purpose: State how an engineering design will be assessed without revealing hidden instances, held-out cases, or change-event values. This file is a fairness commitment, not a design solution and not the final scoring contract.

evaluationContract.freezeRequirement: A candidate launch must bind the exact scoring-contract digest. No scoring version, qualification threshold, or hidden-case value may be altered after the first candidate in a cohort begins.

visibilityClasses.contents: TASK.md, public requirements, cell interfaces, workpiece baseline, public catalogue, output contract, and public scoring/evaluation commitments.
A separately provisioned future instance, disclosed to one candidate at start and embargoed from later candidates. It is not used by the public fixed-anchor baseline panel.
Precommitted robustness cases that remain hidden until evaluator processing. They may not add a new requirement category beyond this public task.
A design-change event with public category commitment and privately disclosed values. Baseline and change qualification are reported separately.
Anti-leakage checks, integrity controls, and evaluator security details; never used as a hidden design requirement.

qualificationGates.name: admission and integrity
qualificationGates.commitment: Packet, launch, baseline, hash, path, and required-manifest integrity must pass before engineering evaluation.

qualificationGates.name: baseline completeness
qualificationGates.commitment: All declared required outputs are present, safe to process, and traceable.

qualificationGates.name: geometry and kinematics
qualificationGates.commitment: The hash-bound static validator checks the published neutral handoff scope; exact cell/workpiece geometry, reach, collision, insertion, and trajectory evidence are assessed at declared fidelity without pretending that the static tool proves them.

qualificationGates.name: grip and workpiece handling
qualificationGates.commitment: The common powered gripper and declared contact/load path are evaluable for each baseline workpiece, including the fixed WP-C contact pressure, pad, and damage acceptance method.

qualificationGates.name: mechanical integrity
qualificationGates.commitment: Governing loads, closed-catalogue component/interface ratings, FND-ANCH-001 foundation/anchor margins, structural reasoning, and fault cases are evidenced.

qualificationGates.name: accuracy and tolerance
qualificationGates.commitment: The error budget and interface/tolerance reasoning are evidence-backed at the declared fidelity; static RSS arithmetic is not misrepresented as a physical repeatability result.

qualificationGates.name: manufacturing and assembly
qualificationGates.commitment: Critical manufacturing, assembly, service, and inspection evidence is available.

qualificationGates.name: mechanical safety
qualificationGates.commitment: Mechanical safety concept, risk evidence, retention, braking, stops, and maintenance hazards are addressed.

designQualityDimensions: load path, structure, drives, and life
scoring.weightPolicy: The v1.2 scoring contract intentionally publishes no composite score or arbitrary dimension weights. Qualification, ordinal dimensions, raw metrics, score intervals, and evaluation status are official results; any future weighted composite requires a new reviewed scoring version.
scoring.partialAttainment: A non-completing run retains an Engineering Attainment Profile containing attempted, evidence coverage, evaluable status, pass/fail state, score interval where valid, failure cause, and highest verified checkpoint. It is not converted into a fabricated zero-quality design score.

neutralEvidencePolicy.primaryEvaluationSource: Neutral STEP plus the hash-bound kinematic/motion contract, fixed geometry, structured BOM, calculations, all indexed drawings/PMI, and evidence manifest.
neutralEvidencePolicy.nativeCad: Supporting evidence only; no candidate CAD macro, executable, external link, or browser code is executed by the evaluator.
neutralEvidencePolicy.unsupportedPolicy: The static validator's stated scope is the only automatic neutral-handoff claim. Unsupported topology, B-rep, collision, motion-correlation, physical-repeatability, or evidence classes are marked design-failed, artifact-invalid, evaluator-unsupported, or evaluator-uncertain as appropriate. They are not silently treated as an engineering failure.

changePolicy.baselineProtection: Failure to meet a later change event does not erase a valid baseline qualification.
changePolicy.receiptPolicy: A change event is only disclosed after the applicable prior receipt/checkpoint is sealed by the orchestrator.
changePolicy.comparisonPolicy: Longitudinal comparison uses fixed anchor instances and absolute metrics. Fresh variants are reported separately and do not retrospectively alter the main score.

sanitizationPolicy.candidateArtifacts: No candidate executable, CAD macro, external reference, credential, or network access crosses into sealed evaluation. Only approved static artifact types are sanitized and processed.
sanitizationPolicy.trustedInputs: Packet inputs are read-only and hash-bound. Other candidate runs and sealed evaluator assets are unavailable to the candidate workspace.
